title: The Real Reason Business Deals Fail (And How to Spot a Bad Lawyer Early)
description:
Thinking about buying or selling a small business? In this episode of Deal Makers, deal attorneys Sara Sharp and Mike Dornik pull back the curtain on what really blows up M&A deals—spoiler: it’s not always the numbers.

From negotiation strategies that actually work to spotting lawyers who kill deals instead of closing them, this conversation dives into the real-world challenges of small business acquisitions. Whether you're a first-time buyer or a seller trying to avoid regrets, this is your no-BS guide to building trust, staying sane, and closing smarter.

🔹 Why empathy beats aggression in negotiation
🔹 How to know if your lawyer is helping or hurting
🔹 Common deal-killers you can avoid
🔹 Real-world examples from $500K–$5M acquisitions
